result.title: VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: Visual On-Policy Distillation (OPD) commonly uses cropped or zoomed-in image regions as teacher-side privileged information to improve fine-grained perception in small Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, local pixel-level cues are insufficient for complex visual reasoning that requires global structure, spatial relationships, and high-level semantics. We propose Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation (VC-OPD), which extends teacher-side privileged information beyond local image regions to question-conditioned visual cues. Advanced MLLMs generate cues capturing key visual details, structural relationships, and semantic evidence needed to answer each question. A multi-stage quality filtering process selects reliable cues, which are provided only to the teacher during training. This enables informative token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, helping the student learn to identify and reason over critical evidence directly from the original image. No additional information is required at inference time. Since advanced MLLMs are used only for visual cue generation, VC-OPD is compatible with both open-weight and proprietary black-box models. Experiments on STEM and general visual reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements across model scales over reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation baselines. Notably, a 4B model trained with VC-OPD outperforms many baselines with 8B or more parameters, demonstrating effective capability transfer through question-conditioned visual cues.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VC-OPD，将教师侧特权信息从局部裁剪扩展为问题条件化的视觉线索：由先进 MLLM 生成关键细节、结构关系与语义证据，经多阶段质量过滤后仅在训练时提供，沿学生自生成轨迹进行 token 级蒸馏，使小模型学会从原图定位并推理关键证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关联「视觉证据筛选」与推理监督分配；可供核查线索过滤是否真让学生内部状态保留必要证据，以及训练期特权信息与推理期零额外成本的权衡是否成立。
